title: Hate And Other Triumphs
problem: One-sided: the code only ignores the effects when the opposing side holds the trait; the text reads global.
notes: 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Effects that activate when creatures die are ignored". Fix: H: bc_OnDeath L158: stop the on-death list for every death, not only when the opposing side holds it. vs bugged: mixed. USER DECISION: reverses the earlier 'one-sided by design' (CROSS) reading; the global version also cancels the holder's own side's effects User 2026-10-26: global, as the text reads (no prior design ruling by the user). Fix = extend the trait's existing side test to the bearer's side too; no other changes (e.g. Life And Other Illusions: no extra handling of defenders' when-attacked effects). 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Hate And Other Triumphs on your creature (normal battle, not a boss); let one of your creatures with an on-death trait die: the on-death effect should not fire.

release_notes.intended: Effects that activate when creatures die are ignored (not in boss battles).
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only the effects of the side opposing the holder were ignored.
release_notes.fix: Now on-death effects are ignored for both sides, whichever side holds the trait.
